firstPlayerRule: At the start of the game, player order is set randomly by placing one house from each player on the player order track. Order is re-determined once after the first round's power plant auction and at the start of every later round: the player with the most connected cities goes first.
officialTieBreak: When re-determining order, if players are tied for most cities, the one with the biggest power plant goes first.
clarifications: Because the first order was random, players re-determine player order once at the end of the first auction phase, before buying resources.
In the two-player "Against the Trust" variant, randomly determine the first player; the Trust is always second in order.
